title: Request and response: body, headers, query and params

videos.script:
Every part of a request came from somebody you do not control. {{parts}} The path, the query string, the headers, the body, the cookies. This lesson takes them one at a time, and for each one asks two questions. What does Express hand you? And what do you check before you use it?

{{check}} A link code is checked once, for every route that names one. A limit from the query string becomes a number, inside a range. A body is checked against a list of the fields it may have, and the answer names every problem at once.

{{reply}} Then the other direction. Which redirect a short link should use, and why a permanent one is a promise you cannot take back. Which status code tells a client what to do next. And how a client asks "has this changed?" and gets a reply with no body.

{{trust}} Last, who is asking. Behind a proxy, the address in the request is the proxy's. You will forge the header that names the real client, and see exactly when Express believes it.
